subject.title: sandbox: keep workspaceAccess none workspaces writable

question: What security proof and review bar should a fix meet before making `workspaceAccess: "none"` isolated workspaces writable across sandbox backends?
rationale: The product direction is now strongly indicated by the maintainer comment on the closed strict-gate PR, but changing sandbox write authorization still needs explicit security-boundary proof before automation should implement or land it.

options.title: Approve isolated-writable proof bar
options.body: Require a fix that updates mounts, local and remote bridges, tool exposure, protected skill handling, docs, and tests, plus live Docker/OpenShell proof that writes remain sandbox-local.

options.title: Keep read-only `none`
options.body: Reject the semantic change, document `none` as intentionally read-only, and close or reframe this issue despite the latest maintainer comment.

options.title: Split custom-bind policy
options.body: Fix only isolated `/workspace` writability here and leave writable custom host binds under `none` to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/59718.

recommendation.title: Approve isolated-writable proof bar
recommendation.body: Require a fix that updates mounts, local and remote bridges, tool exposure, protected skill handling, docs, and tests, plus live Docker/OpenShell proof that writes remain sandbox-local.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete provided the current maintainer direction on the related strict-gate PR and has the strongest recent sandbox-area history.
